nodes.name: NFZ-PBA Precipitation
nodes.procedure: 0.366 g of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.239 g of Zn(NO3)2·6H2O, and 0.9885 g of sodium citrate tribasic dihydrate (HOC(COONa)(CH2-COONa)2·2H2O) were dissolved in 60 mL of deionized (DI) water. The mixture was sonicated and stirred for approximately 5 min to obtain a homogeneous solution. In addition, 0.416 g of K3[Fe(CN)6] was dissolved in 60 mL of DI water and added dropwise to the former solution under continuous stirring. The mixed solution was incubated for 24 h at room temperature to precipitate PBA particles. The precipitated powder was centrifuged and dried overnight in an electric oven at 60 °C.

nodes.source_text: NFZ-PBA was prepared using a simple precipitation method. Briefly, 0.366 g of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O... dried overnight in an electric oven at 60 °C.

nodes.name: NFZ-PBA-H Heat Treatment
nodes.procedure: The as-synthesized NFZ-PBA powders were subjected to heat treatment in a tube furnace. The temperature was increased to 350 °C at a heating rate of 10 °C/min and held at this temperature for 6 h under an Ar atmosphere. After dwelling, the temperature was cooled to room temperature for approximately 2 h, and the gas flow rate was fixed at 100 standard cubic centimeters per minute (SCCM) during heat treatment.
nodes.source_text: The as-synthesized NFZ-PBA powders were subjected to heat treatment... gas flow rate was fixed at 100 SCCM during heat treatment.

nodes.name: NFZ-PBA-S Sulfurization
nodes.procedure: The synthesis of NFZ-PBA-S was similar to that of NFZ-PBA-H, except that S powder was placed at the end of the tube for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of sulfur atoms during heat treatment. The amount of S powder was the same as that for NFZ-PBA.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show small nanograins of 5-10 nm formed on surfaces of NFZ-PBA-H and NFZ-PBA-S while retaining initial cubic morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: small nanograins of size 5-10 nm formed on the surfaces of NFZ-PBA-H and NFZ-PBA-S, while their initial cubic morphology is successfully retained, as shown in the scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images

nodes.characterization_summary: Broadened peaks in PXRD confirm phase transformation from PBA to nanocrystalline/polycrystalline transition metal (oxy)hydroxides; sulfur deposition does not affect crystalline nature.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The phase transformation from PBA to nanocrystalline or polycrystalline transition metal (oxy)hydroxides is confirmed by the broaden peaks in powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) results

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows cubic morphology of NFZ-PBA-S with surface nanograins; SAED patterns indicate polycrystalline nature.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) was performed to study the crystalline structure of NFZ-PBA-S in detail. Fig. 2(c) shows the cubic morphology of NFZ-PBA-S with surface nanograins.

nodes.characterization_summary: HR-TEM detects d-spacing of approximately 2.71 nm corresponding to (100) planes of β-Ni(OH)₂, confirming phase transformation from PBA to LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution TEM (HR-TEM) detected a d-spacing of approximately 2.71 nm corresponding to the interplanar distance of the (100) planes of β-Ni(OH)₂

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM-EDX mapping shows homogeneous distributions of Ni, Fe, Zn, O, and S in NFZ-PBA-S with atomic ratios of 27.5, 22.5, 10.5, 35.9, and 0.38% respectively; post-OER mapping confirms continued homogeneous distributions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM-EDX mapping was performed on NFZ-PBA-S for elemental analysis, where homogeneous distributions of Ni, Fe, Zn, O, and S were clearly observed (Fig. 2e) with relative atomic ratios of 27.5, 22.5, 10.5, 35.9, and 0.38%, respectively... homogeneous distributions of Ni, Fe, Zn, O, and S were confirmed by TEM-EDX mapping images (Fig. 6d).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p XPS shows Ni close to 2+ valence state; S 2p peaks at 169.38 eV (S-O) and 163.78 eV (S-M); Zn 2p and Fe 2p indicate Zn²⁺ and Fe³⁺ oxidation states.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the Ni 2p XPS spectra, two symmetric Ni 2p peaks... are assigned to the Ni 2p₃/₂ and Ni 2p₁/₂ core levels, respectively, where the valence state of Ni is close to 2+. The deconvoluted peaks at 169.38 and 163.78 eV are attributed to the sulfur-oxygen (S-O) and sulfur-metal (S-M) bindings, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Fe K-edge XANES shows mixed Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺ states, more oxidized in NFZ-PBA-S; Ni K-edge shows ~2+ state, slightly reduced in NFZ-PBA-S; XAFS shows modified local atomic arrangements due to S substitution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Their Fe K-edges are between the Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺ references, indicating mixed oxidation states of Fe in both samples... the oxidation state of Ni is ~2+ in both samples.

nodes.characterization_summary: Work functions: NF-PBA-H (6.90 eV), NFZ-PBA-H (8.30 eV), NFZ-PBA-S (7.35 eV), indicating Zn as p-type dopant creating negatively charged surfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The results show that the work function (Φ) of NF-PBA-H (Φ = 6.90 eV)... is substantially increased when Zn-dopants are introduced (Φ = 8.30 eV for NFZ-PBA-H)... When sulfur atoms are incorporated into NFZ-PBA, its work function was reduced (Φ = 7.35 eV for NFZ-PBA-S)

nodes.characterization_summary: TOF-SIMS mapping reveals presence of S-species before/after OER and confirms polyatomic anions (sulfate, carbonate) on NFZ-PBA-S surface before and after saline OER; sulfur atoms anodically etched during electrolysis.
nodes.evidence_snippet: time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (TOF-SIMS) mapping of NFZ-PBA-S before and after electrolysis in a salt electrolyte reveals the presence of S-species... TOF-SIMS mapping results also confirm the existence of polyatomic anions (i.e., sulfate and carbonate) on the surface of NFZ-PBA-S before and after the saline OER

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR shows S=O stretching vibrations at 1403 cm⁻¹ in NFZ-PBA-S, confirming sulfur incorporation; absent in NFZ-PBA and NFZ-PBA-H.
nodes.evidence_snippet: FTIR spectrum of NFZ-PBA-S showed the existence of stretching vibrations of S=O together with the O–H, C-N, C-O, and C=O... The absence of stretching vibrations of S=O at 1403 cm⁻¹ in NFZ-PBA and NFZ-PBA-H

nodes.characterization_summary: Cdl values: NFZ-PBA-H (0.0357 mF cm⁻²), NF-PBA-S (0.0631 mF cm⁻²), NFZ-PBA-S (0.1133 mF cm⁻²), corresponding to ECSA values of 0.89, 1.58, 2.83.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Cdl (ECSA) values of the catalysts were calculated as 0.0357 (0.89), 0.0631 (1.58), and 0.1133 mF cm⁻² (2.83) for NFZ-PBA-H, NF-PBA-S, and NFZ-PBA-S, respectively

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM-EDX mapping confirms existence of sulfur atoms at the surface of NFZ-PBA-S.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM energy dispersive X-ray (SEM-EDX) mapping results confirm the existence of sulfur atoms at the surface of NFZ-PBA-S
